newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar holds steady, eyes on NY expiry.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar holds steady, eyes on NY expiry.

text.p: London white sugar futures were reluctant to stray too far from opening levels on Friday but most traders' attention was focussed on the little time remaining before New York's March expiry.
"All eyes are being focussed on the March expiry and it's quite traditional when you have two expiring close together, we tend to get this quiet period in London," said one trader.
London's March contract expired earlier this month, while New York's spot raws contract expires at close of CSCE business on Friday.
"It (London May) looks pretty comfortable trading anywhere between $310 and $303," he said.
Earlier, crossed trades on the nearby months accounted for the bulk of London's thin activity, along with May/August crosses and some outright trades.
At 1730 GMT May was up just 20 cents at $308.30 after moving in a tight $1.60 range. August was unchanged at $307.80 and volume amounted to a modest 1,561 lots.
Technically, May is holding above an upward trendline dating from last month's low of $293.50 and back up from the first Fibonacci retracement level at $305.20.
The retracements are based on the rally from $293.50 to $312.50, the high of February 20.

Technical analysts said the market was still looking positive and they would take a bullish stance while the spot value held above the trendline. Nearby resistance was placed at $310 followed by $312.
Activity in Paris was quiet with just 283 lots on the board and only the two nearby months trading.
May was up $1.20 at $308.20 and August up 70 cents at $307.60. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
